Adapted from dsh-mnemon-strategy-default-three-tier 0.5.11, MIT.
Source: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/tree/main/plugins/dsh-mnemon-strategy-default-three-tier

Changes: friend-three-tier registration; ordinary/complex read quotas; shared 12000-character/8–12-result envelope; distinguish the exact Native sparse_results no-hit advisory from service failures while retaining it in evidence metadata. Source identity, quality policy, replay, dependency boundaries and persistence backends retained. No changes to Native databases or record IDs.
